title: The Twin Antler School Course
summary: The school course in growing a matched pair of antlers of bone and locking and goring with them in turn.

title: The Mirror Bone School Treatise
summary: The school treatise on glassy bone that throws a blow back at the one who struck it.

title: The Ivory Crown School Canon
summary: The school's high canon of bone refined to ivory and raised over the head as a crown that rules the exchange.

title: The Oath of the Standing Marrow
summary: The school oath of swearing the marrow to hold the stance and standing against the whole weight of the wind.

title: The Long Bearing Rib School
summary: The school manual of casting ribs along a long bearing so they fly true and strike as one volley.

title: The Wind-Sworn Skeleton Crown
summary: The school's high edict of a skeleton hollowed and sworn to the wind and crowned with a single edict of bone.
